title: DeBank Portfolio Snapshot Sync Gap Watch
dataSources: Crypto prices/holdings (`crypto:price`, `wallet:balance`), exchange transactions (`coinbase:txn`), budget/transaction exports (`firefly:txn`, `ynab:txn`), recurring-subscription and bill feeds.
app: Crypto exchange/wallet APIs (Coinbase, on-chain), budgeting exports (YNAB/Firefly III), and subscription trackers via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=debank:portfolio
| stats max(_time) as last_seen by chain
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| where hours_since>6
| sort - hours_since
description: Detects when DeBank portfolio snapshot data has stopped arriving for a given chain.
value: Personal telemetry is only useful when it is current; sync-gap alerts catch failed exports and broken credentials early.
implementation: Track the latest event time per chain and alert when the feed is older than 6 hours.
visualization: Table of entities by hours since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It directly when one part of your DeBank portfolio snapshot feed has stopped checking in and probably needs fixing.
